_note: Hand-transcribed from the sources named in each entry (short keys explained in docs/modelling_choices.md). Cycle counts are integers exactly as printed; 'kc' values are thousands of cycles as printed.

sizes._source: FIPS203 Table 3 (p.39); FIPS204 Table 2 (p.16); FALCON Table 3.3 (p.51) and pqm4 fndsa_provisional api.h; round-2 Dilithium from GKS21 Table 1

round3_sig_sizes._source: pqm3 crypto_sign/dilithium2/m3/params.h: CRYPTO_BYTES = SEEDBYTES + L*POLYZ_PACKEDBYTES + OMEGA + K

m0plus._source: M0P (arXiv:2603.19340v6) Tables IV, V, IX; RP2040 Cortex-M0+ 125 MHz, PQClean reference C at PQClean commit 3730b32a, -O3, campaign A; cycles = t(us) x 125 (derived, not counted); stack in KB = 1024 bytes, printed to 0.1 KB

gks21_m3._source: GKS21 Table 4 (p.19): Cortex-M3 SAM3X8E at 16 MHz, averaged over 10000 executions; round-2 Dilithium; speed in kcc (thousand clock cycles); stack in bytes. Strategy 1 additionally needs 23632/34896/48208 bytes of flash for precomputed values (footnotes a-c).

huang_m4._source: HUANG Table 6 (p.21), 'This work' rows, Cortex-M4 via pqm4, averaged over 1000 executions; round-3 Dilithium/Kyber; row mapping checked against the paper's stated 13.94% and 9.42% sign speed-ups

pornin2025_m4._source: P25 Table 1 (p.1), STM32F407 at 24 MHz; RAM = transient work area + stack; sign figures are the BUFF variant

pornin2026_m4._source: P26 Table 1 (p.34) Arm Cortex M4 row, STM32F407 at 168 MHz, code in SRAM, data and stack in CCM, no wait states; 'average clock cycle count', printed rounded; RAM p.33: temporary area 20n bytes (standard code 59n) plus stack 992 bytes measured on Cortex-M4. Digits recovered via pypdf glyph names (D-X1).

pornin2019_m4._source: P19 section 5.3 table (p.19), STM32F407 at 168 MHz with caches; averages over 200; expanded-key sizes and temporary storage p.14-16. Digits recovered via pypdf glyph names (D-X1).

masking._source: AZ22 section 6.3 (p.16): two-share masked Dilithium3 signing 'is 4.3x slower than the unprotected implementation in the randomized case and 7.32x in the deterministic case' (per execution, excluding rejection repetitions). IDEMIA p.18: side-channel countermeasures for their KEMs 'could bring significant overhead, up to doubling the execution time'.

idemia_table4._source: IDEMIA Table 4 (p.19), Kyber, ms; rows reconstructed so that T->C + C->T + card = total

chips._source: Chip data briefs (Infineon SLC36/37PDx, ST31N600, ST31P450, NXP P71D321). RAM in KB of 1024 bytes (D-M2). clock_mhz null = not stated.

Infineon SLC37PDx.payment: brief: payments; 14 KB for PDx448/400, 'up to 16 KB'
